item.title: EDITORIAL: Keep isles’ doctors with strategy, tech
item.description: The doctor shortage in Hawaii is bad, and it’s getting worse. The state was short 833 doctors last year — a spike upward from 768 in 2024 — as the need grew and supply shrank. There were 3,044 full-time equivalent physicians in practice, 31 fewer than in 2024.

item.title: TAX MAN: Tax versus Judiciary
item.description: While our Legislature is busily considering changes to our tax laws, the courts are also helping us work through the laws we already have. There are two Hawaii Supreme Court cases pending that involve fights over the extent to which courts can get involved at all.

item.title: Kauai and Kapaa boys play off for Round 2 on Monday
item.description: LIHUE — Based on results from Friday night’s boys basketball games, there will be a playoff contest between Kauai and Kapaa. boys basketball teams today for the control of the Kauai Interscholastic Federation Round 2.

item.title: Schofield soldiers forced to ‘double up’ in barracks with more troops coming
item.description: Some soldiers on Oahu are being told they might be living “doubled up” in their barracks rooms for at least 15 months or longer as the U.S. Army increases the number of troops in Hawaii under a major force restructuring.

item.title: Hawaii visitor arrivals end 2025 well below pre-pandemic peak
item.description: Hawaii ended 2025 with nearly flat visitor arrivals and a tourism economy still short of its pre-COVID peak — and below what many hotels and small businesses say they need to stay afloat.

item.title: Injured hiker assisted on Uluwehi Falls Trail on Saturday
item.description: WAILUA — Personnel with the Kauai Fire Department assisted an injured 33-year-old male visitor on the Uluwehi Falls Trail, commonly known as Secret Falls, on Saturday.

item.title: Mimasaki Sister City delegation visits Kauai
item.description: LIHUE — Fifteen students and Sensei Elton Ushio of the Lihue Kendo Club were privileged to have a private practice session with Naofumi Hara, 8th dan kendo instructor, or sensei, and Miki Tadamasa, 7th dan kendo female instructor, at the Lihue Hongwanji Mission social hall Saturday.

item.title: Hawaii health officials investigate chickenpox outbreak at Kauai school
item.description: The Hawaii Department of Health today said it is investigating an outbreak of chickenpox at Kilauea Elementary School on Kauai.
